The Rebbe states: 'זֶהוּ בְּעַצְמוֹ שֶׁמְּדַבֵּר הוּא בְּחִינַת הִתְגַּלּוּת הִתְעוֹרְרוּת לִבּוֹ וְנַפְשׁוֹ' and then summarizes: 'הַדִּבּוּר בְּעַצְמוֹ הוּא הִתְגַּלּוּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהַלֵּב'. Speech is not an instrument that produces soul-revelation — it IS the soul-revelation. This is a structural identity (bechina), not cause-and-effect. Node belongs to the package of דיבור-soul-revelation.

The Rebbe invokes this verse to demonstrate that speech and soul-going-out are the same event. This verse-node belongs to the same package as דיבור and התגלות הנפש והלב, as it is the scriptural anchor of the entire bechina identification.
